matter_background.original: By a Deed of Gift bearing No.409 dated 4th June 2001 attested by G.W. de Silva Notary Public Nimal the Donor gifted his son Asanka No. 400A, "Waters Edge" Akuregoda Road, Pelawatta, Battaramulla a house and property. The relevant clauses in the Deed of Gift are as follows. Recital All that building called "Waters Edge" bearing Assessment No.400A together with the land whereon the said building is situated free of all encumbrances whatsoever. Operative Clause All that allotment of land with the building standing thereon bearing Assessment No.400A situated in the said lot marked "C" and which said Lot "C" is morefully described in the schedule hereto.. Schedule All that allotment of land marked Lot Cin Plan No.450B dated 18th May 2000 made by Anil Silva, Licensed Surveyor of the land called Dawatagahawatta with the building called "Waters Edge" bearing Assessment No.400A standing thereon situated in the said allotment of land which contains two buildings bearing Assessment Nos.400 and 400A in extent of 32 perches.
